title: Keiki (Children) | Saltay Hanalei Bay
description: Explore Saltay’s offerings for younger guests, with parent accompaniment and botanical facials from age nine.
heading: A gentle introduction to Saltay
introduction: Explore bodywork and botanical experiences for children. A parent must accompany their child throughout the chosen session.
hero_image_alt: Ocean waters along the coast of Kaua‘i
note: Contact us to discuss the right session, duration, and pricing for your child before booking.

items.title: Bodywork & botanical care
items.text: Published Keiki options include acupuncture, cranial sacral therapy, push/pull massage, ear candling, respiratory steam, fire cupping, sound frequency, and botanical foot soaks. Speak with the team about your child’s age and an appropriate choice.

items.title: Jewel of the Siren
items.text: The Jewel of the Siren botanical facial is available for children aged nine and older. Explore the Signature Experiences page to learn about this facial ritual.

items.title: A parent by their side
items.text: Share your child’s age, preferred experience, and scheduling needs when you contact us. A parent accompanies the session; the team can help you plan the details.
